title: HONOR 600S winner goes on a PHP 1 million shopping spree at SM Lanang
summary: Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines brought the excitement of its HONOR 600S PHP 1 Million Shopping Spree Promo to Davao City as it officially awarded Mary Ann D. Asis with PHP 1 million…

blocks.text: Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines brought the excitement of its HONOR 600S PHP 1 Million Shopping Spree Promo to Davao City as it officially awarded Mary Ann D. Asis with PHP 1 million worth of SM Gift Passes during a special ceremony at SM Lanang.

blocks.caption: HONOR Philippines’ Vice President Stephen Cheng, Digital Marketing and Content Head Eason De Guzman, Public Relations Head Pao Oga, and SM Store’s Assistant Branch Manager Silverio Calamba officially award Mary Ann D. Asis with PHP 1 million worth of SM Gift Passes during the HONOR 600S PHP 1 Mil…

blocks.text: Together with representatives from SM Store, HONOR Philippines celebrated the lucky winner as she received her prize, marking the highlight of the promotional campaign that gave one customer the chance to enjoy a shopping spree worth PHP 1 million.
A Shopping Spree Worth PHP 1 Million

Following the award ceremony, Mary Ann began her shopping spree inside the SM Store, where she explored different sections and selected the items she had been looking forward to. With her shopping carts gradually filling up, she got to make the most of her PHP 1 million worth of SM Gift Passes.

“Masaya na naging part ako ng promo na ito at nanalo ng PHP 1 million worth of SM Gift Passes. Maganda rin talaga ang HONOR 600S kasi matagal siyang malowbat, durable din, at pwede mong i-convert into video ang mga images mo. Maganda rin ang feature na iyon. Snapdragon na rin siya kaya mabilis na,” said Mary Ann D. Asis, winner of the HONOR 600S PHP 1 Million Shopping Spree Promo.
Through promotions like the PHP 1 Million Shopping Spree, HONOR Philippines continues to bring exciting experiences closer to its customers while celebrating the people who support the brand.

The HONOR 600S combines innovative AI features, a versatile camera system, and a long-lasting battery to support users in their everyday activities. With this special campaign, one lucky customer got to take home more than just a new smartphone experience, but also a memorable shopping spree worth PHP 1 million.
